items.title: Live: Australians come together to mark Anzac Day
items.description: Australians, including Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Opposition Leader Angus Taylor, gather to commemorate Anzac Day at dawn services this morning. Follow live.

items.title: Trump says Iran's regime is 'fighting like cats and dogs'. This is the reality
items.description: After a wave of assassinations targeting top Iranian officials and a supreme leader who has not been seen in public since the war began, a key question has emerged: who is really running Iran?

items.title: Live: Witkoff and Kushner heading to Pakistan for talks with Iran
items.description: It comes as fighting continues between Israel and militant group Hezbollah in southern Lebanon where an extended ceasefire is in place. Follow live.

items.title: Israel's killing of journalists in Lebanon highlights the impunity with which it acts
items.description: According to the Committee to Protect Journalists, the Israel Defense Forces have committed more targeted killings of journalists than any other government's military since 1992.

items.title: Australian 'ISIS brides' leave camp in Syria months after failed attempt
items.description: A group of Australian families with ties to former Islamic State fighters, who have been stranded in a Syrian refugee camp, have begun another attempt to travel home to Australia.

items.title: The 'internationally acclaimed' French sculptor who is nowhere to be found
items.description: An Australian gallery has been selling sculptures as the work of an "internationally acclaimed" French artist. But the Paris backstory doesn’t stack up.

items.title: The chart that shows how much the NDIS price tag has blown out
items.description: An analysis of price forecasts in previous budgets reveals the NDIS was on track to cost more than four times what was initially expected.

items.title: One Nation's outcome in Farrer could be a watershed moment
items.description: The Coalition's preference deals in Farrer could help fracture the Liberal Party's moderate base and invigorate dissatisfied voters.

items.title: James Valentine knew good radio and I was his wide-eyed apprentice
items.description: As an aspiring broadcaster, I covertly watched everything James Valentine did on air. He taught me how in the absurd minutia of our lives, we reveal ourselves to each other.

items.title: Leaked Pentagon email shows US wants to punish NATO allies over Iran war
items.description: The email suggests the US may review the UK's claim to the Falkland Islands and Spain's NATO membership as punishment over their stance on the Iran war.

items.title: Virginia Giuffre's legacy and the year that followed the Epstein files release
items.description: Virginia Giuffre didn't live to witness the full impact of the truths she brought forward, but the arrests, resignations and the unravelling of reputations came in the wake of her decision to speak.

items.title: Netanyahu delayed revealing prostate cancer diagnosis due to Iran war
items.description: Benjamin Netanyahu said a malignant tumour was discovered during a routine check-up and he has since undergone "targeted treatment".

items.title: Inmates accused of sexual assault in prison continued to share cells, report finds
items.description: A Queensland Ombudsman report has found three instances where prison inmates accused of sexually assaulting cellmates have continued to share cells with other prisoners.

items.title: 'Things could get ugly': CFMEU interference under spotlight at inquiry
items.description: The commission of inquiry into the CFMEU has this week heard the union had a complex relationship with the former Labor government.

items.title: How Paul Dempsey became Australia's 'king of covers'
items.description: From Taylor Swift to Cher, Paul Dempsey's cover versions have been lauded. But does he have a secret weapon to making the perfect cover?

items.title: Quiz: Test yourself on The Shawshank Redemption, hair metal and Bugs Bunny
items.description: Every question has only two options: one is right, and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: The isolation of rural Australia causes chaos in Alphabet Lane
items.description: Director James Litchfield brings his experience growing up in rural Australia to his debut feature film, Alphabet Lane.

items.title: Vic govt announces $860m for 7,000 extra social housing properties
items.description: An extra 7,000 social housing properties will be built in Victoria in the coming decade, with an initial $860 million investment in the state budget, the Allan government has announced.

items.title: 'Homophobia has no place': AFL boss rejects ruling on slurs in sport
items.description: Both the AFL and the AFL Players' Association hit back at suggestions from the appeals board that slurs are commonplace among players in the sport.

items.title: Ruthless Demons notch big win as Richmond's winless season continues
items.description: Melbourne eases to a 54-point over Richmond at the MCG, as the hapless Tigers remain the competition's only side without a win in 2026. Follow live.

items.title: Broncos score two NRL Try of the Year contenders in win over Bulldogs
items.description: Injury-hit Brisbane stands tall at a wet and wild Lang Park, scoring two remarkable tries in a 32-12 defeat of Canterbury-Bankstown.

items.title: 'Just do it': Why the gas tax momentum is building for Australia's good
items.description: Gas giants are breathing a sigh of relief after Prime Minister Anthony Albanese ruled out a 25 per cent tax on exports in next month's budget. But for how long will the federal government resist something that one leading expert says is in our "national interest"?

items.title: Kyle Sandilands vows 'truth will raise its head' in case against ex-employer
items.description: Kyle Sandilands and Jackie 'O' Henderson have separately launched legal proceedings following the termination of their $100 million contracts.

items.title: Court shown Rebel Wilson text exchange about actor's bath incident
items.description: A Sydney court is shown a text message exchange between Hollywood star Rebel Wilson and a movie producer over a bathroom incident involving a young actor.

items.title: Pentagon awards $276m AUKUS contract funded by Australia
items.description: The US Department of Defense announces the first major submarine contract to deliver on the AUKUS security deal.
